ValidationRule.description: A Major Change related Processing Status (Approved or Not Approved) must be selected if Major Change is set as the Sub-Category, the Case is part of the NAS process and is Closed.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Major Change or Fee-Waiver related Processing Status (Approved or Not Approved) must be selected if Major Change or Fee Waiver is set as the Sub-Category, the Case is part of the NAS process and is Closed.
